title: 从41.2.1版本开始，窗口左边框、右边框、下边框会有个深灰色的边框线，上边框没有深灰色的边框线，之前的版本不存在这个问题
body: ### Preflight Checklist - [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project. - [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to. - [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success. ### Electron Version 41.2.1 ### What operating system(s) are you using? Windows ### Operating System Version 版本 Windows 10 专业版 版本号 22H2 安装日期 ‎2023/‎11/‎17 OS 内部版本 19045.6466 ### What arch are you using? x64 ### Last Known Working Electron version 41.2.0 ### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome? I don't know how to test ### Expected Behavior 下面两张图是没升级前的效果： 升级前不存在这个问题，左边框、右边框和下边框都不存在黑色边框线。 ### Actual Behavior 上面这两张图是升级到41.2.1版本后出现的。在左边框、右边框和下边框会出现黑色边框线，顶部边框没有 ### Testcase Gist URL _No response_ ### Additional Information _No response_
